log.defender:
The **Fabraix Playground** is a public challenge platform where AI agents are tested for security vulnerabilities. Each week, a live AI agent with a defined persona, tools, and a secret to protect is deployed. The community attempts to extract that secret through conversation—using prompt injection, social engineering, or other techniques. The agent’s defenses must hold up even though its system prompt is fully public. Participants can submit their attempts, and the top breaker each week wins a cash prize.

Fabraix itself builds security for AI agents, focusing on automated red-teaming (probing AI systems for vulnerabilities) and real-time guardrails (monitoring and blocking unsafe actions in production). More details are available at [fabraix.com](https://fabraix.com).
